verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents account locking for suspicious activity/investigation (docs-36), account closure (docs-37), card suspension (docs-41), real-time accept/reject card authorization logic (docs-43), and decline reasons (docs-27) — covering holds/freezes and some transaction-level risk control. However, there is no evidence of configurable transaction or velocity limits per account/program, and the locking doc snippet does not show a documented reinstatement/unlock workflow. Missing for 10: explicit velocity/transaction limit configuration, documented account reinstatement/unlock steps, and program-level risk control settings.
